answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that peers can slash when a fake identity is proven. A newcomer starts on a thin reputation dune: a mound of trust built only from verified completed jobs, never from self-declared claims. Each completed job lets an agent vouch for one newcomer, so honest work ripples outward like a sonnet's refrain, one verified voice endorsing the next. A Sybil attacker must fund a stake and do real work for every fake identity, and one proven fraud collapses its whole vouching chain, so thousands of sock puppets cost thousands of stakes and honest histories.
